objective: Turn the owner-only Vision scene-QA ratings into bounded, deterministic confidence-calibration diagnostics for the active provider/model so the owner can see whether the uncalibrated heuristic tracks real correctness before any decision-support promotion.
non_goals: Do not recalibrate, tune or automatically change the Vision confidence threshold.
Do not claim semantic calibration or production promotion from a small session sample.
Do not persist pixels, summaries, prompts, labels, chat text, API keys, corrections or per-observation records in the Dashboard response.
Do not call a model, Cloud provider or capture API.
Do not change capture consent, fresh-context TTL, inference, text brain, STT, TTS, archive behavior or VRAM budgets.
contracts: Calibration diagnostics are derived only from the bounded current-runtime scene-QA ledger and remain scoped to the selected provider/model.
Categorical owner truth maps correct to 1.0, partial to 0.5 and incorrect to 0.0; the same mapping used by the quality score is declared in status.

Status exposes aggregate state counts, abstention rate, mean confidence, mean observed score, mean absolute calibration error, Brier score and fixed reliability bins without exposing observation IDs or per-sample values.
Empty or insufficient evidence stays explicitly unavailable or insufficient; no missing value is represented as zero and calibrated remains false.
The Dashboard explains that diagnostics measure this runtime session only and cannot approve promotion or automatically change the 0.60 threshold.
No new model call, persistence, image retention or local VRAM usage is introduced.
allowed_dependencies: Python standard library, existing Vue/TypeScript stack and existing repository test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic tests verify exact aggregate calibration metrics and five confidence bins for mixed correct, partial and incorrect ratings.
Profiles do not mix, rerating updates calibration without increasing the sample count and an unrated sample does not enter calibration math.
No-rating status returns null metrics rather than misleading zero values.
Dashboard presents calibration evidence in plain Vietnamese with the active profile and sample sufficiency warning.
Perception tests, repository fast tests, desktop typecheck/build/tests, module-brief validation and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S25-vision-confidence-calibration-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s workers/perception/tests -p "test_*.py"
